topic: POINTCLOUD definition/reactor DXF writer version transaction matrix

generatedFields: record identity, owner handle, variant kind and class version
definition variants: long RCS/RCP path, loaded state, 64-bit point count and extents

validation.rollback: Every injected allocation failure preserves the previous destination and caller record.
validation.retry: Same-codec retry after each injected failure reproduces the clean reference bytes.
validation.readback: Fresh typed callback readback verifies revision, record variant and every serialized modeled field.

proves: Generated transaction behavior for all four public POINTCLOUD definition/reactor writer variants across seven target revisions and two encodings.
doesNotProve: ACAD_POINTCLOUD dictionary membership or recursive entity/definition/reactor graph closure.
Independent producer interoperability or external RCS/RCP asset loading.
Native point-cloud rendering or broader 3D support.
